_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The Lord God helps me; I set my face like flint.
Make haste, O God, to deliver us.
At the table, Jesus hands the morsel to the one who will betray him.
Judas went out, and it was night.
Surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us run.
Looking to Jesus, who endured the cross.
Come, let us run the race set before us.
We follow the servant to the cross. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: The room is close and troubled; Jesus dips the bread and hands it to the one whose heart has already turned.
We follow the servant to the cross.
The door opens, the friend goes out, and the gospel says simply: and it was night.
We follow the servant to the cross.
Yet the servant does not turn back; he sets his face like flint and trusts the God who is near.
We follow the servant to the cross.
Around us a great cloud of witnesses leans in, and before us the race is laid.
We follow the servant to the cross.
So lay aside every weight, fix your eyes on Jesus, and run.
We follow the servant to the cross. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: He hands the bread to the one who will betray him.
Here is the servant of God.
The door opens; the friend goes out; it is night.
Here is the servant of God.
He sets his face like flint and does not turn.
Here is the servant of God.
Surrounded by witnesses, we run the race.
Here is the servant of God. Amen.
